wellnessCards.title: Rest is part of productivity.
wellnessCards.message: Taking breaks can help you recharge and maintain focus.
wellnessCards.action: Take a five-minute pause between tasks today.
wellnessCards.detail: Rest supports attention and gives you room to reset. Try stepping away from your screen, stretching, or getting a glass of water before you return to your work.

wellnessCards.title: Small steps are still progress.
wellnessCards.message: You do not have to accomplish everything in one day.
wellnessCards.detail: Large goals often become easier to approach when you name the first small action. Notice what you complete, even when the day does not go exactly as planned.

wellnessCards.title: Your mental wellbeing matters.
wellnessCards.message: Give yourself time to recognize your emotions and seek support when needed.
wellnessCards.action: Pause and name one feeling you have today.
wellnessCards.detail: Noticing how you feel can help you decide what you need. If something feels difficult to carry, a trusted person or qualified professional can help you explore it.

wellnessCards.title: Break big tasks into smaller steps.
wellnessCards.message: Organizing academic responsibilities can make challenging workloads feel more manageable.
wellnessCards.action: Write down the first ten-minute task.
wellnessCards.detail: Pick one specific action you can complete soon, such as outlining a paragraph or reviewing one page. Then decide what comes next.

wellnessCards.title: Healthy boundaries matter.
wellnessCards.message: Respecting your limits is an important part of healthy relationships.
wellnessCards.action: Think of one need you could express clearly.
wellnessCards.detail: A boundary can be a clear, respectful statement about your time, energy, or comfort. Healthy conversations leave room for both people to be heard.

wellnessCards.title: Make time to move.
wellnessCards.message: Regular physical activity can contribute to general wellbeing.
wellnessCards.action: Find a way to move that feels comfortable today.
wellnessCards.detail: Movement can be simple: a short walk, stretching, or another activity you enjoy. Choose an option that works for your body and your day.

wellnessCards.title: It is okay to ask for help.
wellnessCards.message: Reaching out to someone you trust can be an important step towards support.
wellnessCards.action: Identify one person or service you could contact.
wellnessCards.detail: You do not need to have a perfect explanation before reaching out. A simple “I could use someone to talk to” is enough to begin.
